day_01.title: To Be in Technical Environments

daily_vocabulary.example: The web server is ready for traffic.
There is an issue with the auth system.
The hotfix is deployed and active.
There is a delay in data processing.

day_01.prompt: Escribe la oración completa rellenando el espacio en blanco para reportar una caída ('The database _____ down'):
day_01.explanation: Usamos 'is' porque 'database' es un sustantivo singular en tercera persona (equivale a 'It' o 'El sistema').
